title: Spring Data JPA with & without Spring Boot

items: Reduces boilerplate code for database access.
Automatically provides CRUD operations by extending JpaRepository.
Integrates with Spring Boot for auto-configuration.
No need to configure EntityManager, TransactionManager, or DataSource manually.
Import project into STS: File > Import > Existing Maven Project
Add the following logic in InfyGoApplication.java to get user input and call service.
